initialization.new_common_relation_rows: semantic random seed, own-profile Xavier bank scale as approved in Prompt7
initialization.G0P: Copy fresh same-fold G0 common parameters; empty relation attention/message zero, priority one.
initialization.state_materialization: after authorization; bind zero optimizer steps and tensor/file SHA before fit

label_policies.L-orig: Original author node/file labels; every original supervised unit included.
label_policies.L-audit: Node target=C1; C2_include is loss/metric mask, never delete a graph node or flip an excluded label. Contract/file labels unchanged.
label_policies.always_report: Original-label score over ALL original outer-test supervised units, even L-audit-masked nodes.
label_policies.interpretation: C1 plus C2 mask is a diagnostic annotation policy, not established vulnerability ground truth.

scoring.keyword_baseline_task_scope: node tasks; E defines node/function keyword predictions
scoring.contract_keyword_baseline: not defined by E; no invented file aggregation

statistics.single_seed_aggregation: equal-fold mean and sample standard deviation
statistics.multiple_seed_aggregation: mean folds within seed, then mean and sample standard deviation across seeds
statistics.pair_unit: fold for one seed; (fold, seed) for multiple seeds

node_wilcoxon.all_zero: statistic n*(n+1)/4; p=1; no normal approximation needed

statistics.a12: all cross-distribution pairs: P(profile > baseline) + 0.5*P(tie); not paired win fraction

holm.interim: raw p only; adjustment pending until full four-comparison family

statistics.interpretation: folds share training data; intervals are descriptive, not independent-seed or causal evidence

statistical_label_scope.primary: User-selected label policy; unchanged four-profile Holm family
statistical_label_scope.auxiliary_orig: Separate original-label reference; never combine its p-values with primary diagnostic labels

selection_rule.tie_break: fewer canonical relations; then profile name

numerical_proof.parameter_copy: Every G0 parameter identical; added empty relation rows zero/priority1
numerical_proof.limitation: At a fixed layer input, only message mean denominator changes. With stacked layers, nonlinear hidden states and attention can then change; final logits are not a constant scalar multiple.

G0P.comparison: G0P-G0 separately for node tasks; excluded from old four-comparison Holm family

execution_gate.executor_integration_required: Explicit N-anon-s feature, selected label mask and grouped-fold binding; G0P uses G0 token view with archived empty schema. Validate executor before any fit.

limitations: Frozen textual clone detector may miss semantic/renamed clones; grouping reduces known cross-fold duplication, not all leakage.
Inner and outer groups are disjoint, but full-graph inputs remain transductive.
No result selection based on new outer-test scores or seed search.
Final experiments are intended for a sufficient-VRAM server; current RTX3050 restriction is local.
Frozen grammar enum_value/yul_identifier nodes are not identifier nodes and remain unchanged.
String/comment content is preserved; passing P2/P3 does not eliminate all source/template cues.
Spelling bijection includes unknown external members, so transformed source is a feature view, not promised deployable Solidity.
Model proof uses CPU eval forwards with saved zero-step initials; no training trajectories measured.

interpretation.nonSolidiFI: pooled counts; no strong small-sample inference
interpretation.anonymity: Only selected identifier spellings; not full Solidity semantic equivalence or absence of all shortcuts
interpretation.final_device: Sufficient-VRAM server planned; local 4GiB is development constraint; server not measured
